purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (claims) software — patient number input processing subprogram
purpose.summary: This subprogram (ORCSPTNUM) handles patient number input processing for the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It accepts a patient number or patient name, validates and normalizes the input (half-width/full-width character checks), then looks up the corresponding patient ID or name in the patient master database. It returns a return code indicating success, no data found, or ambiguous match.
